headline: On October 20, 2003: Sloan Great Wall Discovered
captionCards: Sloan Great Wall: Once the largest known cosmic structure
Helps map the universe and understand its vastness
instagramCaption:
Princeton University students made a cosmic discovery. \\[J. Richard Gott III and Mario Jurić, along with their colleagues, announced the discovery of the Sloan Great Wall (SGW), a giant wall of galaxies, on October 20, 2003. This structure, based on data from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey, was once the largest known cosmic structure. The SGW's discovery expanded our understanding of the universe's large-scale structure. \\[Why is this still important today? It helps us map the cosmos and understand its vastness. \\[What do you think is the most fascinating part of the universe? \\[Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
